verdict.rationale: Orb runs several configurable billing processes on its own in the background: automatic invoice issuance after grace periods, dunning retries at 1, 4 and 9 days, automatic recalculation of invoices when late data arrives, scheduled daily data exports, usage-threshold alerts, and automatic credit top-ups. Webhooks let external systems react to these events. These are fixed, domain-specific behaviors you switch on, not a general way to define your own background automations. Missing for 10: a general automation or workflow builder for user-defined triggers and actions, agent-driven or AI-native automation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
